title: SC seeks Centre, Punjab reply on plea alleging 15-year delay in RTE quota implementation
summary: The Supreme Court has sought responses from the Centre and Punjab government regarding a plea alleging a 15-year delay in the implementation of the Right to Education (RTE) quota. This legal action highlights significant concerns about educational access in the state.
digest: The Supreme Court of India has issued notices to both the Central government and the Punjab state government, demanding their replies to a petition filed before it. The plea specifically alleges a substantial 15-year delay in the proper implementation of the quota provisions under the Right to Education (RTE) Act.
